overview: We connect your product to a payment provider such as Stripe so customers can subscribe or pay once, and your app knows who has paid. faq: Which payment providers do you work with?

Stripe is our default because its docs and test tools are strong. We can also set up PayPal, Paddle or Lemon Squeezy if they suit your country and product. You need your own account with the provider.
Do I need a business entity to take payments?

Providers set their own rules for who can open an account and where payouts go. We cannot change those rules. Check the provider's requirements for your country before ordering, and we can walk you through the form.
The provider charges fees per payment, billed to your account. Our price covers the setup only. We list the current fee structure in your handover notes so there are no surprises.
Can you move existing customers onto the new billing?
Yes, for a small number of customers by import or manual setup. Large migrations with saved cards need the provider's own migration process, which we can plan but not speed up.
